acceptance: Members and rubric scores are recorded in this item's context before registration; the cutover preconditions and their evidence are recorded before the first register_batch.

Every member lands through batch-land and is prepared; the final PR merges into develop through pr-open and pr-arm with oracle-gate passing on its final head; every member is finished against final evidence.

The pilot report in this item's context lists members, landing order, integration failures, stale or lost evidence, conflicts and the effort to resolve them, overlap reruns, verification time, review fixes and rebinds, and any manual tracker repair.
The report states pass or fail against the default-mode rubric: final PR merged, no manual tracker repair, no unresolved lost or stale evidence, no gate bypassed.
